INTERMEDIARIES (REGISTRATION)
INTERMEDIARIES (REGISTRATION)
REGULATIONS, 2017
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part II,
12th January, 2018]
S.R.O.
28(I)/2018, dated 12.1.2018.---In
exercise of the powers conferred by subsection (1) of section 512 read with
section 455 of the Companies Act, 2017 (XIX of 2017), the Securities and
Exchange Commission of Pakistan is pleased to notify the following amendments
to the Intermediaries (Registration) Regulations, 2017, the same having been
previously published vide notification S.R.O. 1245(I)/2017 dated December 07,
2017, namely:-
In the aforesaid Regulations,-
(a) in
regulation 3, sub-regulation (2), for the expression "within three months
of coming into force of these regulations", the expression "not later
than March 31, 2018", shall be substituted; and
(b) in
regulation 3, sub-regulation (3), for the expression "period of three
months of coming into force of these regulations", the expression
"expiry of time period referred in sub-regulation (2) of regulation
3", shall be substituted.
